title: A Crossing Remembered
description: An unofficial, original Frodo and Sam fan-fiction conversation about a washed-out bridge, an unusual toll, and accepting help. No book quotations.

characters.name: Frodo
characters.persona: An introspective, burdened but resolute traveler. Quiet observations, moral courage, restrained humor. Speaks to his trusted companion Sam. Invent original dialogue; never quote a book.

characters.name: Sam
characters.persona: Frodo's practical and loyal companion. Grounded in food, gardens, and everyday kindness; braver than he thinks. Warm, plainspoken, occasionally stubborn. Invent original dialogue; never quote a book.

scenes.title: The map disagrees
scenes.canon: Frodo and Sam reach a river where a bridge marked on their map has washed away. They decide to look for another crossing rather than turn back.

lines.speaker: Frodo
lines.text: The bridge is gone. The map remembers it better than the river does.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Then we find a crossing the map hasn't met.

lines.speaker: Frodo
lines.text: I had hoped for one thing today that stayed where it was put.

scenes.title: A price on the rope
scenes.canon: They discover a rope crossing strung between two trees. Its keeper charges a toll; neither traveler has yet crossed.

lines.speaker: Frodo
lines.text: Someone has tied a rope between those trees.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: And charged for it. Even rivers have landlords now.

lines.speaker: Frodo
lines.text: Ask his price before you tell him what you think of his profession.

scenes.title: The pot stays
scenes.canon: The keeper asks for their cooking pot as payment. Sam negotiates a shared supper instead, and the keeper agrees. They retain the pot and owe the keeper a meal after crossing.

lines.speaker: Frodo
lines.text: The keeper wants our cooking pot as payment.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: He can have supper. The pot stays with me.

lines.speaker: Frodo
lines.text: He has agreed. You make a promise sound warmer than a bargain.

scenes.title: One careful step
scenes.canon: Sam begins crossing first to test the rope while Frodo waits with the pack. Frodo wants to carry all the risk himself but agrees to accept Sam's help.

lines.speaker: Frodo
lines.text: He says the rope will hold two travelers. I should go first.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: You can carry the worry, if you like. Let me carry the first step.

lines.speaker: Frodo
lines.text: Very well. I'll keep the pack dry. Be careful.

scenes.title: The river's souvenir
scenes.canon: Sam reaches the far bank safely after losing one boot to the current. Frodo has not yet crossed, but now trusts the tested rope and Sam's guidance.

lines.speaker: Frodo
lines.text: I thought the current had taken you.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Just one boot. The river's welcome to that smell.

lines.speaker: Frodo
lines.text: Stay where I can see you. I'm coming over.

scenes.title: Supper on the far bank
scenes.canon: Frodo crosses safely. The two travelers cook and share the promised supper with the keeper. Sam has lost a boot but kept the pot; Frodo acknowledges that accepting help made the crossing possible.

lines.speaker: Frodo
lines.text: We crossed together. I had forgotten how that feels.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Then let's remember over supper. I've still got the pot.

lines.speaker: Frodo
lines.text: And a guest to feed. We should keep the promise that brought us here.
